name: Morgan L. Escott
summary:
Creative Content Strategist with 10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS and agency environments, specializing in connecting messaging to activation and transforming raw inputs into cohesive, high-performing content across diverse channels. I bring a storyteller's precision to every narrative, a systems thinker's rigor to every workflow, and a collaborative mindset to every project. Proven ability to leverage AI-assisted workflows for content acceleration and apply editorial judgment to refine outputs. Best known for human-first messaging that drives engagement, building content infrastructure that lasts, and operating as a flexible generalist across a range of content and campaign needs.

Career note: After a fulfilling run at Treering Yearbooks, I took intentional time in 2024–25 to support a loved one's health and invest in professional growth. I'm excited to return with renewed focus and a sharper sense of where I do my best work, particularly in remote, mission-driven environments.

experience.title: Creative Strategy Lead & Senior Sales Development Manager
achievements: Founded and chaired the Content Committee, a cross-department body unifying Sales and Marketing, owning brand voice, a full sequence library, campaign QA processes, and ongoing content governance to ensure messaging consistency across outputs.

Authored 100+ email campaigns across niche audience segments (Title 1, Private School, PTA Councils, Hot Zone districts), translating core messaging into activation-ready content for diverse audiences.
Built and maintained comprehensive voice/tone guidelines adopted team-wide, setting the benchmark for quality and consistency in all external communications.
Developed and delivered live + asynchronous training for 20+ employees on messaging, content strategy, and platform best practices, adapting complex ideas into clear, actionable guidance.

Created a comprehensive 8-step SDR process map (escottmorgan.wixsite.com/processmap) used as official new hire training infrastructure, building lightweight workflows for efficient content distribution and process adherence.
Achieved 74% open rate and 22% reply rate for PTA Council campaigns with zero opt-outs, demonstrating exceptional messaging effectiveness for a notoriously hard-to-reach audience.
Achieved 85% open rate and 39% reply rate for Hot Zone Spring 1st Touch sequence (89 contacts), showcasing precision in campaign execution and messaging activation.

Launched the January 2022 sequence suite of 6 campaigns, achieving a 63% average open rate (every sequence above 50%), 8.7% reply rate, and 4.3% click rate across 3,337 prospects, proving repeatable campaign success.
Translated raw inputs, including competitive landscapes and internal conversations, to tailor campaign messaging and improve response rates, operating as a flexible generalist across content needs.
Introduced AI tools (ChatGPT/Grammarly) into the campaign workflow to scale personalization and accelerate content development, applying editorial judgment to refine outputs.

Led selection and implementation of Outreach.io as the primary sequencing platform, managing CRM integration, data migration, and team-wide adoption training to build robust outbound engagement infrastructure.
Uncovered $3M+ in stale Salesforce pipeline through systematic CRM data hygiene and re-prioritization, demonstrating strong attention to detail and a bias toward action in content operations.
